text_block_list.text:
After a day out with Нарита Брайан, we
decide to
have dinner together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm fine with just some fast food.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't take long, and we can get
takeout.
Sounds good, right?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Well, if it isn't Brian!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: What are you doin' here?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: We're just about to get some fast food.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Fast food? You don't mean for dinner,
do ya?
Unbelievable!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And you! You're supposed to be a
trainer! It's
your job to manage her diet,
ya know?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
...Oh, right! I just thought of somethin'!
Come with
me a sec!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: H-hey!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
All right, tell me what you wanna eat
tonight!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: What the heck is this?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Listen, Brian. You gotta eat somethin' at
least a
bit healthier than fast food.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Even at the academy, you only eat bread
or
sandwiches for lunch. You don't use
the cafeteria
much, right?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
There's too many people at the
cafeteria. It's too
much trouble. I just
want to eat alone in peace.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Maybe so, but just eating bread isn't a
balanced
diet.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Go to the cafeteria. They'll serve ya a
balanced
meal without you even havin'
to think about it.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I don't care what I eat, as long as it fills
my
stomach.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Well you should! C'mon, isn't there any
kind of
food you like?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...Can't you just let it go?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Why do you care so much about what I
eat? It has
nothing to do with you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Nothing to do with me?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Right, well, I don't really care about the
logic at
this point! I'm sayin' this because
I'm worried
about you!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I don't want my rival taken off the track
for
somethin' that's not even to do with
racing!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
So... ya gotta stay healthy. Otherwise it
affects
me!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Anyway... I get what you're trying to say.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I'll stop eating fast food. Satisfied?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: If ya really understand... then okay. Sure.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
All right, well, I might as well make ya
some
dinner! Got anythin' you wanna
eat?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...Anything's fine.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
That's the hardest answer to work with...
C'mon,
there's gotta be something!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: You decide. You're my trainer, after all.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Okay, that then.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Somethin' well-balanced it is! Leave it to

Hishiama! I'll whip ya up somethin'
perfect!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Just you wait!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
...I'll keep my expectations within
reason.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, might as well. That'd probably be
good.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Stamina, eh? All right, leave it to
Hishiama!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna cook you up something nice
and
hearty!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: With a lot of meat.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I thought ya'd say that! All
right, leave it
to me!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I ask her about it a few days later, and
she says
Hishi Amazon's cooking was
delicious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I ask her about the meal a few days
later. She tells
me that, while it wasn't as
hearty as she'd hoped,
it was still very
tasty.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
